project_inclusion.note: Species-level package; local varieties can be split later if useful.

morphology_keys.life_cycle: Perennial in the Williamson County treatment; broader treatments note substantial variation.
morphology_keys.habit: Twining or trailing vine with a taproot and long lateral roots.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate; ovate-deltoid to shallowly 3-lobed, cordate at base; leaf shape variable.
morphology_keys.sepals: Outer sepals about 8–11 mm, usually ciliate/hairy; inner sepals about 10–12 mm.
morphology_keys.corolla: Pink to purple, usually about 2.5–4.5 cm, darker in the throat.
morphology_keys.key: Shorter, broader sepals than I. hederacea; perennial rooting habit also helps.
